reports.title: DIAMONDBACK ENERGY, INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS; INCREASES BASE DIVIDEND

guidance.heading: UPDATED 2026 GUIDANCE HIGHLIGHTS
section: •Increasing annual oil production guidance to ~524 (from 522+) MBO/d with total BOE production of ~1,015 (from 1,000+) MBOE/d and full year cash capital expenditures to $3.95 - $4.00 billion (from ~$3.9 billion)
•Q4 2026 oil production guidance of 518 - 528 MBO/d (1,025 - 1,045 MBOE/d)
•Q4 2026 cash capital expenditures guidance of $1,000 - $1,050 million

1 NON-GAAP DISCLOSURES - For a definition of Operating Cash Flow Before Working Capital Changes, Free Cash Flow, Adjusted Free Cash Flow, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income per Diluted Share, Net Debt and reconciliations of such non-GAAP financial metrics to their respective most directly comparable GAAP metrics, please see “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below.
2 Cash dividend payable on November 19, 2026; annualized yield based on October 30, 2026 closing share price of $212.08
